_doc: Starter OKRs and rubric for a new video. Edit the objectives and targets BEFORE producing, run scripts/measure_video.py after the export, score each rubric row 0-10 with evidence, then run scripts/build_okr.py. {braces} are filled from assets/metrics.json.
value_proposition: <One sentence: who the viewer is, what they will be able to do after this video, in how many minutes.>

objectives.title: <A viewer with problem X leaves knowing what to check and what to do next>

krs.text: The problem is on screen within 10 s
The first concrete action is shown within 30 s
A recap lists at least 4 concrete takeaways at the end
Average view duration of at least 40% (YouTube Analytics, first 28 days)
At least 10 comments saying it helped or that they found the answer (first 28 days)
The community card stays on screen at least 8 s with the URL
The URL is in the description and the pinned comment
At least 30 clicks on the community link in 14 days
At least 5 new members say this video brought them (join question), 14 days

objectives.title: Ship a clean, private and reusable video, fast

krs.text: No private text visible in the export (OCR check of every 2 s)
Integrated loudness within 1.5 LU of -14 LUFS
True peak at or below -1.5 dBFS
Steady background noise at most 5 dB above the clean part after the fix
Dead air (silence over 3 s) at most 5% of the runtime
Every chapter at least 10 s (YouTube rule)

score.scale: Each dimension 0 to 10 (0 = absent, 5 = present but weak, 8 = good, 10 = excellent and proven). Weighted to 100. This is the producer's pre-publish estimate from measured evidence; replace it with the real numbers after 28 days.

rows.evidence: Problem on screen at {time_to_problem_s} s (title card, then "What we are doing" slide); first action (Settings, Capabilities) at {time_to_first_action_s} s.
Summary lists {summary_points} takeaways; steps are shown live (quit and reopen, update the Mac, remove the old copy). The main answer is "wait", which limits how much a viewer can do.

{dead_air_percent}% dead air ({dead_air_seconds} s while the canvas builds) and {stutter_spots} stutter spots are still in; runtime {export_seconds} s for a mostly negative result; speech pace {words_per_minute} words per minute is fine.

Loudness {loudness_lufs} LUFS, true peak {true_peak_dbfs} dBFS (0.3 dB over the -1.5 target), hoover noise now {noise_haze_max_db_after_fix} dB above the clean part, animated captions, no transitions, {blur_boxes} blur boxes and {privacy_leaks} private lines left.
{chapters} chapters, shortest {chapter_min_len_s} s; recap at the end; description, tags and pinned comment written.
Community card after the recap for {cta_seconds} s with the URL; URL also in the description and pinned comment; one ask, no promises.

after_publish: Day 2: impressions click-through and first-30-s retention.
Day 14: community link clicks and the join question "Which video brought you here?".
Day 28: average view duration and helpful comments; replace pre-publish scores with real evidence.
